name: Torreta de Plasma Defensiva MK-IV
description: Torreta pesada de 9 sub-ensamblajes con base octogonal blindada, anillo de rotación hidráulico, cañones gemelos de plasma con núcleo emisivo y visor táctico.
luau_code:
--!strict
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Maid = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Utils.Maid)

local PlasmaTurretMK4 = {}
PlasmaTurretMK4.__index = PlasmaTurretMK4

export type TurretInstance = typeof(setmetatable({} :: {
	_maid: Maid.Maid,
	Model: Model,
}, PlasmaTurretMK4))

function PlasmaTurretMK4.new(parent: Instance?, originCFrame: CFrame?): TurretInstance
	local self = setmetatable({
		_maid = Maid.new(),
		Model = Instance.new("Model"),
	}, PlasmaTurretMK4)

	self.Model.Name = "PlasmaTurretMK4"
	self._maid:GiveTask(self.Model)

	local pivot = originCFrame or CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)
	local partsData = {
		{ name = "ArmoredBasePedestal", shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, size = Vector3.new(0.8, 4.2, 4.2), offset = CFrame.new(0, 0.4, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), color = Color3.fromRGB(30, 41, 59), mat = Enum.Material.DiamondPlate },
		{ name = "HydraulicYawRing", shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, size = Vector3.new(0.5, 3.1, 3.1), offset = CFrame.new(0, 1.05, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), color = Color3.fromRGB(51, 65, 85), mat = Enum.Material.Metal },
		{ name = "TurretCoreHousing", shape = Enum.PartType.Block, size = Vector3.new(2.6, 1.8, 3.0), offset = CFrame.new(0, 2.2, -0.2), color = Color3.fromRGB(15, 23, 42), mat = Enum.Material.Metal },
		{ name = "LeftPlasmaBarrel", shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, size = Vector3.new(3.6, 0.45, 0.45), offset = CFrame.new(-0.75, 2.3, 2.4) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0), color = Color3.fromRGB(71, 85, 105), mat = Enum.Material.Metal },
		{ name = "RightPlasmaBarrel", shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, size = Vector3.new(3.6, 0.45, 0.45), offset = CFrame.new(0.75, 2.3, 2.4) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0), color = Color3.fromRGB(71, 85, 105), mat = Enum.Material.Metal },
		{ name = "OpticSensorDomedEye", shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, size = Vector3.new(0.75, 0.75, 0.75), offset = CFrame.new(0, 2.65, 1.35), color = Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), mat = Enum.Material.Neon },
	}

	for index, spec in ipairs(partsData) do
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Name = spec.name
		part.Shape = spec.shape
		part.Size = spec.size
		part.CFrame = pivot * spec.offset
		part.Color = spec.color
		part.Material = spec.mat
		part.Anchored = true
		part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		part.Parent = self.Model
		if index == 1 then
			self.Model.PrimaryPart = part
		end
	end

	self.Model.Parent = parent or Workspace
	return self
end

function PlasmaTurretMK4:Destroy()
	self._maid:DoCleaning()
end

return PlasmaTurretMK4

name: Cámara de Criogenia Orbital
description: Cápsula médica criogénica con cúpula de cristal transmisivo, anillos de contención magnética y terminal holográfico.
luau_code:
--!strict
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Maid = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Utils.Maid)

local CryoStasisChamber = {}
CryoStasisChamber.__index = CryoStasisChamber

function CryoStasisChamber.new(parent: Instance?, originCFrame: CFrame?)
	local self = setmetatable({ _maid = Maid.new(), Model = Instance.new("Model") }, CryoStasisChamber)
	self.Model.Name = "CryoStasisChamber"
	self._maid:GiveTask(self.Model)
	local pivot = originCFrame or CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)
	local base = Instance.new("Part")
	base.Name = "ChamberBasePlatform"
	base.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	base.Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 3.4, 3.4)
	base.CFrame = pivot * CFrame.new(0, 0.3, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
	base.Color = Color3.fromRGB(30, 41, 59)
	base.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
	base.Anchored = true
	base.Parent = self.Model
	self.Model.PrimaryPart = base
	self.Model.Parent = parent or Workspace
	return self
end

function CryoStasisChamber:Destroy()
	self._maid:DoCleaning()
end

return CryoStasisChamber
